about: Client loader state of an instancing folder (the folder of '*group_*.lsf' instanced-scenery files of a level). ls::InstancingSystem::StartNewFolderLoads (Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0x977BB0) starts an asynchronous folder read with the path held at +0 (AsyncFileReadManager::AsyncLoadFolder(request, component, "*group_*.lsf")), keeps the read requests and allocates 0x100-byte ls::InstancingBatchLoader objects; FinishFolderLoad/ProcessBatchModifications use them. Seen alive after level changes and recruit/dialog trees in new areas.

evidence.says: Game creator bg3.exe+0x1851ED0 (size 0x38) constructs an ls::STDString at +0 from an empty global and zeroes +0x18..+0x37. Toolkit passes the component itself as the folder path to AsyncLoadFolder. Live: heap buffer at +0, size 0x7C..0x95 at +0x10, capacity 0x7F/0x8F/0x9F at +0x14 (long path strings).

Toolkit +0x20 (game +0x18; the Toolkit STDString is 8 bytes larger): ls::SharedPtr<ls::AsyncReadRequest> assigned from AsyncFileReadManager::CreateAsyncRequest and passed to AsyncLoadFolder. Live 0 (finished).
Toolkit +0x28: a second ls::SharedPtr<ls::AsyncReadRequest> created for the batch loader (CreateAsyncRequest with the object at +0x38). Live 0.
Toolkit +0x30: replaced by a new object; the old one is torn down (GameEngine.dll+0x6F6C60 on old+0x80) and freed with size 0x100 align 0x40; also used as the request's category argument. Live 0.
Toolkit +0x38: an ls::InstancingBatchLoader allocated with GameEngine.dll+0xA49A20 (size 0x100, alignment 0x40) (the local holding it is typed InstancingBatchLoader*). Live 0.

open_questions: Offsets of the four pointers are shifted from the Toolkit build by the STDString size difference (Toolkit 32, game 24) - consistent with the game's 0x38 size and zeroing, not checked in game code.
